name: Anah
overview: Anah is identified in Scripture as a son of Seir the Horite and a descendant of Zibeon, with a notable role in the genealogy of Esau's family. Although some texts refer to Anah as the 'daughter' of Zibeon, this is likely a copyist's error, and he is more accurately understood as either father-in-law or mother-in-law to Esau through his daughter Aholibamah. Additionally, Anah is also called Beeri and is remembered for discovering mules in the wilderness while tending to his father's asses, highlighting a unique personal contribution within this lineage.
